set.pl: Chappell land N of Leoni village, E of the Michigan Central (1911 plat); knoll in the former swamp not fixed; lidar check pending
pinev: 1911 Ogle Jackson Co atlas, Leoni plate pp. 76-77 (archive.org 3927885.0001.001.umich.edu leaf 0078): 'S. E. Chappelle 214' just N of Leoni village and E of the Michigan Central, wet ground along the track; 'S. E.
